# Medicorp Brace Finder (mock-up)

> Demonstration website for "Medicorp", a placeholder orthopedic brace company. Clinicians describe a patient in one sentence (age, sex, height, weight, condition) and the site suggests a matching brace and size, then shows a mock checkout. All company details, products, prices and HCPCS codes are placeholders. Not medical advice; no real orders.

## Pages

- [Home and brace finder](https://rbickmore664.github.io/medicorp-mockup/): one-sentence patient description to brace match
- [Catalog](https://rbickmore664.github.io/medicorp-mockup/#/catalog): 14 braces across knee, back, neck, wrist, ankle, shoulder
- [How it works](https://rbickmore664.github.io/medicorp-mockup/#/how)
- [FAQ](https://rbickmore664.github.io/medicorp-mockup/#/faq)
- [Privacy & HIPAA](https://rbickmore664.github.io/medicorp-mockup/#/privacy): how the demo handles patient info
- [Catalog data (JSON)](https://rbickmore664.github.io/medicorp-mockup/data/catalog.json)
- [Full text for LLMs](https://rbickmore664.github.io/medicorp-mockup/llms-full.txt)
